title: MMDG edge record
description: One typed edge of the Meta-Model Dependency Graph, in the single canonical shape used by the spec, this schema, the examples and model-side manifests alike: from, to, edge_type, declared_min, optional version_range, compositional_role, kinds, optional contract_ref, fingerprint_at_registration, declared_by, observed_at, optional note. The edge vocabulary is defined as a delta over ARCH-016: each edge type maps to an ARCH-016 composition mechanism, and compositional_role binds to the ARCH-016 roles R1 to R8 (required on composes and references edges). The node-level role field holds the triad (core, landscape, kernel); the two fields answer different questions and coexist: edge_type is the relationship kind, compositional_role is how the target participates per ARCH-016. Edge semantics: composes means a Landscape orchestrates a Core model by reference, never by inclusion; references means a model refers to kinds declared in the target's exports, named in this edge's kinds field; masters-link is a pointer into the ARCH-018 mastership register (sources.yaml), never a free restatement of mastership as graph data; deprecated-in-favor-of is the successor pointer per ARCH-002 deprecation, whose declared_min names the earliest successor version. Version handling: declared_min is a minimum version only and is the sole resolver input; resolution is Minimal Version Selection (per-model maximum of declared minimums, major versions as distinct identities); version_range and any other declared compatibility predicates act only as publish-time validation predicates enforced by V-gates and never drive the resolver. CI enforces referential integrity (both endpoints registered), export coverage (every entry in kinds appears in the target record's exports), agreement between this edge's declared_min and the from-record's requires min_version for the same target and kind, acyclicity of composes, and non-empty intersection of the publish-time predicates on all edges into one model. No composes edge leaves the kernel node. Inlined for offline validation: endpoint ids use the inlined registry id pattern rather than a remote reference.

from.description: Registry id of the declaring node. For composes and references this is the model that consumes; for deprecated-in-favor-of it is the deprecated node.

to.description: Registry id of the target node. For deprecated-in-favor-of it is the successor.

edge_type.description: Closed kernel-owned edge vocabulary for v0.1. Node vocabularies stay open and domain-owned; the edge vocabulary stays closed.

declared_min.description: Minimum version of the target this edge was validated against; for deprecated-in-favor-of, the earliest successor version. The sole input to Minimal Version Selection. Never an upper bound: upper bounds live in version_range as publish-time V-gate predicates, not resolver inputs.

version_range.description: Optional declared compatibility range. Publish-time validation predicate enforced by V-gates only; never a resolver input.

compositional_role.description: Binding of this edge to an ARCH-016 compositional role, required on composes and references edges. Bound by reference: the role semantics live in ARCH-016 and are not restated here. Never a repetition of edge_type.

kinds.description: The target's exported kinds this edge references, namespace-local names. Required on references edges; permitted on composes edges. CI export coverage runs on this field: every entry appears in the target record's exports.

contract_ref.description: Optional reference to the composition contract governing this edge.

fingerprint_at_registration.description: Semantic Fingerprint per ARCH-009 of the target model version this edge was validated against at registration time. The semantic pin; never a byte hash.

declared_by.description: Identity of the declaring registrant, normally the registry id of the from node.

observed_at.description: When the declaration was registered and validated.

note.description: Optional free-text annotation. Non-semantic: excluded from ARCH-009 canonicalization and never load-bearing for resolution.
